text: Fantastic Experience !!!! I’d like to thanks a lot the Best Instructor that we know Claudi (Claudio) You are The Best My Friend !!!!
author: ekatz3

title: Excellent Experience
text:
Very Good and Knowledgeable. Really showed and explained the boat and sailing to our son. Also, one of us needed a little extra help during the trip - very friendly and professional!
Thanks a Bunch.
author: nikolettac609

title: Perfect ending of our holidays
text: It was a great trip with many highlights. It is a sporty sailing boat, so not to expect a comfy yacht :) our skipper was very nice, showed us the stunning skyline and explained everything to us! It was a beautiful trip on our last day! We enjoyed very much!
author: Barbara_L

title: So much fun!
text: This sailing tour has been one of our highlights in Barcelona! Our skipper was super nice and fun, and taught our daughter how to sail. She was (and still is) super excited that she got to "drive" the sailboat the entire time. :-) We had a blast!!
author: Anja_R

title: Great Place for a calm sailing experience!
text: It was great. My father and I had lots of fun and even got to sail. We really enjoyed the sailing as well as the beautiful sunset and would recommend it anytime!
author: Jakob_H

title: This relaxing day out on the...
text: This relaxing day out on the Mediterranean was a fantastic way to end our Spanish holiday and I'd recommend it. Thank you very much.
author: Sharon M
